description: Flutter role-based routing + dedicated trainer UI. Adds role to AccountInfo, a role branch in the go_router redirect placed BEFORE the student onboarding gate, a separate Trainer shell (NOT jammed into the student HomeShell) with Dashboard/Students/Progress/Profile tabs on the Midnight Energy theme, the trainer data layer/models/providers, the trainer dashboard with search/sort/filter, the student-detail tabbed page (Overview/Workout/Workout History/Nutrition/Water/Progress/Progress Photos) reusing existing chart widgets, and routing+UI tests. The student HomeShell and all existing student features are untouched. Depends on FEAT-002 (role in verify response + trainer backend endpoints).
steps: Role + routing (design §6.1): add 'final String role;' to AccountInfo in frontend/lib/features/auth/data/auth_repository.dart parsed as account['role'] as String? ?? 'student'. Add trainerHome='/trainer' to frontend/lib/core/routing/route_names.dart. In frontend/lib/core/routing/app_router.dart insert the role branch immediately after accountAsync loads successfully and BEFORE 'final onboarded = ...': if account?.role=='trainer' route to Routes.trainerHome (stay if already there); register GoRoute(path: Routes.trainerHome, builder: (_, __) => const TrainerShell()). Leave the entire student branch unchanged.

Trainer data layer (design §6.5): add frontend/lib/features/trainer/data/trainer_repository.dart wrapping ApiClient for all /api/trainer/* and /api/student/trainer calls returning Result<T>; frontend/lib/features/trainer/data/trainer_models.dart (TrainerProfile, TrainerStudentSummary, StudentOverview; reuse NutritionDay/FoodLogEntry where shapes match); frontend/lib/features/trainer/providers/trainer_providers.dart (FutureProvider and FutureProvider.family keyed by studentUid[+date], matching the nutrition/profile provider style).

Trainer shell + screens (design §6.2-6.3): add frontend/lib/features/trainer/presentation/trainer_shell.dart with its own Scaffold + IndexedStack + a Midnight-styled bottom nav bar reusing AppColors/AppShadows/AppSpacing (mirror the _MidnightNavBar pattern from home_shell.dart; do NOT modify home_shell.dart) with tabs Dashboard, Students, Progress, Profile. Add trainer_dashboard_screen.dart (overview cards: Total/Active students, Today's Activity, Workout Sessions, Students needing attention, Recent activity; student list with client-side search/sort/filter All/Active/Inactive/Recently active/Goal/Progress; each card shows photo, name, goal, current weight, progress summary, last workout, today's activity status, nutrition status, overall progress), trainer_students_screen.dart, student_detail_screen.dart (TabBar/TabBarView with Overview/Workout/Workout History/Nutrition/Water/Progress/Progress Photos, each a FutureProvider.family; reuse existing chart widgets e.g. MacroRing), trainer_progress_screen.dart, trainer_profile_screen.dart.

Edge/empty states (design §6.6): trainer with zero students -> empty-state view (not error); student with no data for a date -> zeroed/empty tab; photo sharing off -> 'not shared' message from the 403; link removed -> detail 404 -> 'no longer linked' and pop; pull-to-refresh invalidates the family provider.

Tests: add frontend/test/trainer_routing_test.dart (role trainer -> trainer shell, student/legacy -> HomeShell), frontend/test/trainer_dashboard_test.dart and frontend/test/student_detail_test.dart (render with empty/loading/data via overridden providers). Follow the existing *_test.dart style.
acceptance_criteria: A trainer-role account routes to the Trainer shell and never hits student onboarding; a student/legacy account routes to the existing HomeShell unchanged.
The trainer shell uses Dashboard/Students/Progress/Profile tabs on the Midnight Energy theme and is a distinct widget tree from HomeShell.
The trainer dashboard shows the required overview cards and a student list with working search, sort, and the specified filters; student cards show the required fields.
Student detail has all seven tabs populated from the student's real backend data with empty/loading states handled (no mock data).
flutter analyze is clean, flutter test passes including the new routing/dashboard/detail tests, and flutter build apk --debug succeeds.
findings:
DONE. Verification GREEN in frontend/: flutter analyze (No issues found), flutter test (104 passed, incl. 9 new trainer tests), flutter build apk --debug (built app-debug.apk; the shell non-zero exit was only Gradle deprecation notes on stderr, build succeeded).

AUTH REPOSITORY ADDITIONS (for FEAT-004 — frontend/lib/features/auth/data/auth_repository.dart):
- AccountInfo now has a server-trusted `final String role` field, parsed as account['role'] as String? ?? 'student', plus a `bool get isTrainer => role == 'trainer'`. The AccountInfo constructor now REQUIRES role (any other test/code constructing AccountInfo directly must pass role: — I already fixed test/auth_restore_test.dart's const _onboarded to add role: 'student').
- New class LinkTrainerResult { bool linked; String? reason; String? trainerId; String? trainerName; } with fromJson.
- New method AuthRepository.linkTrainer(String referralCode) -> Future<Result<LinkTrainerResult>>, POSTs /api/auth/link-trainer with body {referralCode: trimmed}. Unknown code is a soft {linked:false, reason:'invalid_code'} success (not an error). FEAT-004's register flow should call this AFTER verify so the account exists, then invalidate accountInfoProvider so the role branch re-evaluates. There is NO linkTrainerResultProvider yet — FEAT-004 can add a provider/controller wiring as its design dictates.

ROUTING (frontend/lib/core/routing): route_names.dart adds Routes.trainerHome = '/trainer'. app_router.dart registers GoRoute(path: Routes.trainerHome -> const TrainerShell()) and inserts the role branch in the redirect IMMEDIATELY AFTER `final account = accountAsync.valueOrNull;` and BEFORE the onboarding gate: if account?.role == 'trainer' -> redirect to Routes.trainerHome (stay if already there). The entire student branch (onboarding/home) is unchanged. home_shell.dart is UNTOUCHED.

TRAINER FLUTTER SLICE (frontend/lib/features/trainer/): 
- data/trainer_models.dart: TrainerProfile, TrainerStudentSummary (with isActiveToday/recentlyActive/needsAttention getters), StudentOverview (keeps raw profile map + typed getters), StudentWorkout/+Exercise/+Set, StudentWorkoutHistoryItem, StudentWaterDay, StudentProgress/ProgressSeriesPoint, StudentPhotos/StudentPhoto. All null-safe; parse both ISO strings and Firestore {_seconds} timestamps.
- data/trainer_repository.dart: Result<T>-returning wrappers over ApiClient for GET /api/trainer/profile, /students, /students/:uid/{overview,workouts?date=,workouts/history?limit=,nutrition?date=,water?date=,progress,photos}. NOTE the backend envelope quirks reused here: nutrition returns the NutritionDay shape DIRECTLY (ok(res, nutrition)) so it's parsed as NutritionDay.fromJson(json); water returns {dateKey,entries,totalMl} directly; profile/overview/students/workouts/history/progress/photos are wrapped under a named key (profile/overview/students/workouts/history/progress or {shared,photos}).
- providers/trainer_providers.dart: trainerRepositoryProvider, trainerProfileProvider, trainerStudentsProvider, FutureProvider.family studentOverviewProvider(uid)/studentWorkoutHistoryProvider(uid)/studentProgressProvider(uid)/studentPhotosProvider(uid), and FutureProvider.family keyed by typedef StudentDateKey = ({String studentUid, String date}) for studentWorkoutsProvider/studentNutritionProvider/studentWaterProvider. trainerTabProvider (StateProvider<int>) for the shell. Also exported helper todayKey().
- presentation/trainer_shell.dart: SEPARATE Scaffold + IndexedStack + its own _MidnightNavBar (mirrors home_shell's pattern using AppColors/AppShadows/AppSpacing; home_shell NOT modified) with tabs Dashboard/Students/Progress/Profile.
- presentation/trainer_dashboard_screen.dart (overview cards + client-side search/sort/filter All|Active|Inactive|Recently active|Needs attention, StudentSummaryCard list), trainer_students_screen.dart, student_detail_screen.dart (DefaultTabController + 7 tabs Overview/Workout/History/Nutrition/Water/Progress/Photos, each a FutureProvider.family with loading/empty/error + pull-to-refresh; reuses MacroRing from nutrition for the Nutrition tab; a simple inline bar chart for volume-over-time), trainer_progress_screen.dart (cross-student engagement roll-up), trainer_profile_screen.dart (referral code card + sign out via authControllerProvider.logout()).
- presentation/widgets/trainer_widgets.dart: TrainerAvatar, TrainerStatCard, TrainerInfoRow, TrainerSection, StatusChip, StudentSummaryCard, prettyGoal(), relativeDate()/shortDate().

EDGE/EMPTY STATES: zero students -> EmptyView (not error); no data for a date -> per-tab zeroed/empty tab; photos sharing off -> StudentPhotos.shared==false renders a 'Photos not shared' EmptyView (the backend returns {shared:false, photos:[]}, NOT a 403 — so no 403 handling needed for the off case); a per-student detail load failure (incl. the 404 when a link is removed) shows the shared _TabBody ErrorView with a 'may no longer be linked' message + retry. NOTE: ApiClient maps 404 to ServerFailure (not a dedicated type), so the detail page cannot auto-pop on 404 — it shows the error/retry view instead. If FEAT-004/UX wants an auto-pop-on-unlink, ApiClient would need a NotFoundFailure type (flagged, not implemented, to avoid changing shared client behavior).

TESTS (frontend/test/): trainer_routing_test.dart (trainer->TrainerShell, student & legacy->HomeShell; fakes a verified User via mocktail, overrides firebaseInit/authReady/authState/accountInfo/sharedPreferences; avoids pumpAndSettle for the HomeShell case per the existing auth_restore_test pattern), trainer_dashboard_test.dart (loading via non-completing Completer / empty / data / search-filter; sets a tall test surface so lazily-built ListView content is findable), student_detail_test.dart (seven tabs render; empty state when profile null).

GIT: this OneDrive path is NOT a git repo (git commands fail 'not a git repository'), same as FEAT-002 reported. Could not stage/commit locally. All changes are written in-place on disk and must be committed on branch feat/trainer-student-2way from an environment where git works. Changed/new files: frontend/lib/features/auth/data/auth_repository.dart, frontend/lib/core/routing/{route_names.dart,app_router.dart}, frontend/test/auth_restore_test.dart (added role to AccountInfo const), plus NEW frontend/lib/features/trainer/** and frontend/test/{trainer_routing_test.dart,trainer_dashboard_test.dart,student_detail_test.dart}.
